messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: runtime-queue-growth - high inflight & rising 5xxs for hosted-regional (prod-us). alert: runtime.queue.inflight > 1000 for 3m, p99_latency > 2s, 503s up 4x. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/c/Runtime/queue?range=5m

nina: on it. I'm on-call. pinging runtime team. first pass: reduce anonymous max_inflight and enable low-priority shedding.

jia: i'll take runtime knobs. timeline? any customer-facing outages yet?

alex: NOC says a couple customers saw degraded responses -> retries causing higher tail. no full outage.

matt: recommend rolling soft-shed policy immediately: set max_inflight per-worker lower for best-effort routes, and bump ratecap for interactive tier.

nina: agree. plan: 1) apply soft-shed policy, 2) lower max_inflight for best-effort routes from 10->4, 3) bump rate limits for paid tier to reduce backpressure, 4) disable non-essential embeddings hot path.

jia: commands ready. applying soft-shed patch to runtime policy config (can revert).

jenkins/deploy-bot: started deployment 4556667785 of runtime-policy:v2. logs: rollforward 0/5 nodes.

jia: running patch now:
```bash
kubectl -n runtime patch configmap runtime-policy -p '{"data":{"soft_shed":"enabled","best_effort_max_inflight":"4","paid_tier_rate_limit":"60rps"}}'
```

alex: also lowering max_inflight global threshold for queuer from 12->6 to reduce head-of-line blocking. queue controller will rebalance.

nina: matt, can you triage customer-impact list and prepare comms if any customer crosses 5min degraded?

matt: on it. pulling affected IDs -> two customers (acme-inc, test-saas). both on fallback models now. CS notified.

deploy-bot: rollout succeeded on 3/5 nodes, continuing.

jia: soft-shed active. telemetry shows inflight down 35% and p99 latency trending down. 503s dropping.

alex: pushing a temporary routing rule to send new sessions to smaller-quantized variant for best-effort to free capacity.

jia: routing change applied: `route.match: best_effort -> model: gpt-small-q8`

nina: monitoring. if p99 doesn't drop under 1.2s in 3m we escalate to capacity increase. for now keep the soft mitigations and hold on broad rate-limit increases.

matt: CS confirmed degraded messages sent to acme-inc, they accepted mitigation and are on fallback.

alex: postmortem owners? i'll take runtime tuning writeup, jia take playbook updates, nina to own incident comms.

incident-bot: incident acknowledged and being tracked: INC-2026-045. paging quieted.

nina: thanks team. will update AM and close after stability window (20m). :thumbsup:
